findings.problem: "best in town" is on the avoided-words list in voice.md. "Last chance!" and "Sign up today" are also false urgency and salesy, against the warm, plain-spoken voice. (The fixed-price claim is gone.)
findings.fix: Remove "best in town" and the urgency. Write a warm, plain line about a thoughtful, considered renovation design for your space.

findings.problem: Subject "Last chance: renovation design for your home" (44 characters) is within the limit, but "Last chance" is false urgency and salesy.
findings.fix: Use a warm subject, e.g. "Plan your renovation with Naqshar".

findings.problem: Preview "Book now." is within 90 characters but is pushy and gives no reason to open.
findings.fix: e.g. "A few thoughtful first steps for your space".
